title: OS MIDI synthesizer
status: stable
groma:
  id: os-midi-synthesizer
  technology: MIDI (Microsoft GS Wavetable Synth, FluidSynth, TiMidity)
---

A General MIDI synthesizer provided by the operating system or a running software synth. Used as the fallback sound output when no MIDI output is connected, so instruments still change.
